mintAuthority.summary: VGBP's three catalogued native deployments retain arbitrarily expandable issuer mint/admin/upgrade powers, with historical on-chain signing observations unchanged. Current issuer documents establish daily whole-token bank/wallet/ledger and reserve-to-face-value reconciliation. The issuer also lists an Ethereum deployment whose supply is independently observed zero at all four July/August report testing instants and the October 19 pin; its full current authority inventory remains unclosed. Independent Apex reports exist for July and August, but no current September report is published, so no attestation-only or prudential supervision credit is granted.

controls.label: VGBP Base direct minter and role-0 bearer
controls.capDescription: Current raw allowance is 1e27, equal to 1 billion VGBP at 18 decimals; the same address can reset its allowance through role 0.
controls.evidence: At Base block 50066430 (hash 0xec072498b514dd35aa306df07eda42e6a1be97faa49e9edcac8f42f9ad8b08c3), this EOA held roles 0, 1, and 2 with a positive 1e27 raw allowance; read-only mint simulation returned true. One signature can mint within that allowance or use role 0 to configure an arbitrary replacement allowance. Token owner(), VNXManager owner(), and proxy-admin owner() were the same EOA. On-chain data does not establish whether the issuer uses MPC or HSM custody.

On Base and Celo, 0xb65a...09c6 is the current role-1 upgrade admin; either role-0 bearer can grant itself proxy-admin role 1 and call upgrade or upgradeAndCall with no delay.
The Solana Token program is immutable; its mint authority's rotation surface is represented by the Solana direct-minter control.
controls.evidence: The Base and Celo proxies each use chain-local VNXProxyAdmin 0xa5d680c17abcd0df3b9b4d5a7c7d1cae0051dcb4, owned by 0xb65a...09c6. Role-0 bearers are 0xb65a...09c6 and 0xacc5...311a on both chains; each is an EOA and either bearer can reach an upgrade path with no delay. Solana Tokenkeg ProgramData 3gvYRKWyXRR9xKWe1ZjPhLY5ZJRN7KDB4rFZFGoJfFk2 has null upgrade authority.

review.evidence: Historical native control observations remain at Base block 50066430 (2026-08-16T23:16:47Z), Celo block 75021637 (2026-08-16T23:19:55Z) and Solana slot 439735891 (2026-08-16T23:22:32Z). Base/Celo issuer role-0 bearers can authorize arbitrary minter allowances and immediately replace mint logic; the Solana issuer account retains the historically observed uncapped mint path. No historical control pin or unbounded economic semantics is renewed or withdrawn. Reconciliation-only research on 2026-10-20 establishes an issuer-operated daily whole-token comparison: current Minting and Redemption and Asset Segregation documents match bank balances and on-chain wallet balances to the internal ledger daily; Reserve Management requires daily valuation with reserve value at least the face value of all stablecoins outstanding. The authoritative Standards and Contracts registry binds every listed VGBP deployment to the same segregated reserve. Its fourth Ethereum VGBP contract 0x34c9c643becd939c950bb9f141e35777559817cb is independently identified as VNX British Pound, symbol VGBP, 18 decimals, and fixed-block totalSupply is zero at all four Apex testing instants: July 15 block 25541499, July 31 block 25656292, August 14 block 25756720 and August 31 block 25878704; zero is also observed at October 19 block 26224773, hash 0xb76bade8a7897afb028dbcb274932e63efd2d5ede3438010c924c00c84426757, timestamp 2026-10-19T06:16:47Z. These are observed zero liabilities at exact instants, not a continuous absence or immutable no-issuance claim. Ethereum implementation/admin resolve to 0xd1d7193ce1aa7808d577058f48ef8289fc2f81fc and 0x817f8afee1a758faf4492f4844b08dcb57658165; owner is 0x45a149f42ff0b77d148d05904dd7577df36a545a, but complete current role/upgrade authority closure is not certified here. The genuine July and August Apex examinations, signed August 10 and September 8, compare GBP 126,595.48 of Solana/Celo/Base VGBP liabilities to GBP 126,596.33 cash at Bermuda Commercial Bank. They supersede the old no-later-report narrative but no September report is observable, so current attestation-only supervision is not established.
